prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE seamless SQUARE short-grass GROUND MATERIAL for a vertical top-down WWII tactical game. Reference image is the existing game's summer material and establishes FINE TEXTURE density and subdued painterly rendering, not the requested seasonal colors. Generate a NEW material of an extensive patch of low ground-cover turf seen from FAR ABOVE, not a macro photo. CRITICAL SCALE CORRECTION: grass leaves and clusters must be at least FIVE TIMES SMALLER than the prominent plants in the old seasonal textures. At 1024x1024, tiny grass blades are only 2-6 pixels long, the largest indistinct grass patches no more than 10-15 pixels wide, THOUSANDS of tiny mixed-direction strokes spread over the ENTIRE image. After downsampling to 384x384 it should read as restrained fine organic grain, with no recognizable individual tall plant and no star-shaped rosette. Make closely cropped, low/flattened meadow turf, sparse short blade flecks and fine soil grain, with gentle broad natural color mottling. Opaque edge-to-edge, seamlessly tileable in both axes, even diffuse overhead illumination with NO cast shadows, no perspective or horizon. No isolated tufts, upright plants, huge bent leaves, fernlike rosettes, weeds, long stems, flowers, reeds, crops, rocks, trails, bushes, trees, snow, frost, ice, border, labels or text. Fine illustrated natural earth detail, not photographic, not pixel art. Keep high frequency contrast soft so infantry silhouettes remain prominent. Season: SPRING. Muted fresh sage-green short turf, gray olive-green and light green fine new shoots over subtle warm gray-brown earth. Mean ground color approximately RGB 154 167 110, low saturation. Moist living short grass, no bright lime or yellow blossoms.
